author: Adamczyk, K. and others
title: Measurement of the $\tau$ lepton polarization in $B \to D^* \tau \nu$ decays with one-prong hadronic $\tau$ decays at Belle
abstract:
We report the first measurement of the $	au$ lepton polarization $P_	au(D^*)$ in the decay $B 	o D^* 	au 
u$ as well as a new determination of $R(D^*) = \mathcal{B}(B 	o D^* 	au 
u)/\mathcal{B}(B 	o D^* \ell 
u)$ using a data sample of 772 million $B ar{B}$ pairs collected at the $\Upsilon(4S)$ resonance with the Belle detector at the KEKB asymmetric-energy $e^+ e^-$ collider. We reconstruct the signal $B$ meson in the $D^{*-} 	au^+ 
u_	au$ mode with the $	au^+$ decaying to $\pi^+  ar{
u}_	au$ or $ho^+  ar{
u}_	au$. The hadronic $	au$ decays are accompanied by a missing neutrino, which prevents full reconstruction of the event. We use the kinematic properties of the signal to extract the $	au$ polarization. We find $P_	au(D^*) = -0.38 \pm 0.51 	ext{(stat)} {}^{+0.21}_{-0.16} 	ext{(syst)}$ and $R(D^*) = 0.270 \pm 0.035 	ext{(stat)} {}^{+0.028}_{-0.025} 	ext{(syst)}$, consistent with Standard Model predictions.
